from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Money(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary amount mentioned in the judgment or case."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary amount")
    purpose: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g. compensation, penalty")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays, if applicable")
    currency: str | None = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency")

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case, with their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the person or entity")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The role in the case, e.g. 上诉人，被上诉人")

class Court(BaseModel):
    """Information about the court."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court, e.g. 甘肃省武山县人民法院")
    level: str | None = Field(description="Court level or type, e.g. 二审，执行监督")

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal document."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier of the document, e.g. 判决文书 1")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="List of case numbers mentioned in the document")
    court: Court | None = Field(description="The court that issued the ruling")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action, e.g. 婚约财产纠纷")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case: 民事，刑事，行政")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved")
    ruling_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the final ruling")
    specific_orders: list[str] = Field(description="Specific orders listed in the judgment")
    financial_amounts: list[Money] = Field(description="Specific monetary amounts involved in the judgment or claims")
    physical_items: list[str] = Field(description="Specific physical items mentioned (e.g. jewelry, cars)")
    procedural_status: str | None = Field(description="Procedural status, e.g. 终审，执行监督")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
